errors.text_span: Стойностите на вертикалната ос варират от 12 до 16.
errors.evidence: This phrasing is ambiguous. It literally states that the values *of the vertical axis* vary from 12 to 16, but the axis scale itself clearly ranges from 0 to 16. It is the data values (the heights of the bars) that fall within the range of 12 to 16, not the axis itself.
